variant.title: No Boxes Sudoku
variant.description: Each row and column contains every digit once. The standard 3x3 boxes are not used.
rule_guide.title: No Boxes Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row and each column must contain the digits 1 through 9 without repeats.
rule_guide.item_2: The standard 3x3 boxes do not apply in this variant.
